articles.description: Aminata Seck, who is from Senegal, entered the U.S. on a student visa and was detained Aug. 7 at Louisville's airport as she was planning to travel with her team, her attorney said.

articles.headline: Houston transfer Justice Carlton out for season with knee injury

articles.headline: Billie Jean King to present Bluder with Joe Lapchick Character Award
articles.description: Billie Jean King will present former Iowa coach Lisa Bluder the Joe Lapchick Character Award. Bluder will be given the award along with Mike Brey, James Jones and Ernie Johnson.
